_comment: Sample build config for a MANAGING tenant (the MSP's own PIM Manager that publishes the signed baseline). Copy it to managing-tenant.json, replace every value, then run tools/setup/Invoke-PimMspBuild.ps1 -Role Master -ConfigPath <file> (plan), and again with -Apply. Ids and names only -- never a secret. No 'deployIdentity' = the build runs as the administrator signed in in the browser. See config/msp/README.md.
